name: psrr-vs-freq
description: PSRR vs frequency at the ratified binding light-load condition (1 mA), 1kHz and 100kHz spec points called out
claim: README.md Target specification, 'PSRR' row (DR-0004 amendment A7): >50dB @ 1kHz (binding -- light load, per note 1) and >20dB @ 100kHz, at Iload=1mA, C_eff=1uF nominal. The 50mA condition the ratified row also names is not automated in this deck -- see tb_psrr.spice's header comment for why (a real, documented ngspice limitation hit during implementation), left as a follow-up rather than fabricated.
analyses: meas ac vout_1k FIND vdb(vout) AT=1k
meas ac vout_100k FIND vdb(vout) AT=100k

operating_conditions.load_current: 1 mA (binding light-load condition per README.md note 1)
operating_conditions.output_cap: 1.0 uF nominal + 100 mOhm ESR (PSRR row's stated C_eff)
operating_conditions.enable_state: enabled (EN tied to VIN at instantiation)

psrr_1k_db.description: README.md PSRR target: >50 dB @ 1 kHz (binding light-load point)
